topic: Hand wash stations and cable ramps
summary: A rental hand wash station is about 0.67 m wide, 0.55 m deep and 1.57 m tall (26.5 x 21.5 x 62 in) with two-sided foot-pump sinks and 20 to 25 gallon tanks, no power or water line needed; a single-sided basin is about 0.43 m wide, 0.71 m deep and 1.25 m tall. One CDC-based rule of thumb from a rental company is one wash station per four portable toilets. A 5-channel cable protector with ADA-style edge ramps is about 1.33 m wide, 0.48 m long and 4.4 cm high (52.5 x 19 x 1.75 in) and is rated for vehicle wheels; chain several end to end across a path. Where cables cross a walkway or guest route, check with the venue and the fire marshal.
